rows:
“연구윤리 교과목” 중 한 과목 반드시 이수해야함(2022년 1학기 입학생부터 적용).
단, 최대 3학점까지만 인정함.
(연구윤리 교과목을 3학점 초과 이수하여도 최대 3학점까지만 인정)
★ 연구윤리 교과목 ★
1. (기교원) M2480.000100 연구윤리의 이해 (1학점)
2. (공대 공통) M1570.000300 공학연구윤리 및 논문작성법 (2학점)
3. (기교원/ 2022년부터 기초역량 공통교과목으로 변경예정) 990.501A 연구 윤리 (3학점)
※ 동대학원 석사과정 中 “연구윤리 교과목군” 과목 이수 시, 박사과정에서 중복 이수하지 않아도 됨.
2022학년 이전 입학 학생이 공통역량 교과목을 이수한 경우, 졸업년도 기준으로 소급 적용
* 2022년도 이전에 수강한 연구윤리교과목이 총 3학점이 넘는 경우, 3학점으로 제한하지 않고,모두 인정함.
(타전공으로 인정하여 졸업이수학점으로 인정)
ex)
1) 2021년 1학기 연구윤리 교과목 수강 + 2021년 2학기 공학연구윤리 및 논문작성법 수강
=> 연구윤리, 공학연구윤리 및 논문작성법(5학점) 모두 인정
2) 2021년 1학기 연구윤리 교과목 수강 + 2022년 1학기 공학연구윤리 및 논문작성법 수강
=>연구윤리(3학점) 만 인정 / 2022학년 수강과목은 수료학점에 미 인정

original.text: *“공통역량교과목” 리스트는 첨부파일 참조. 주관기관 상황 에 따라 교과목 개설 여부는 변경 될 수 있음.

english: - Graduate common competency courses (organized by 기초교육원 (Faculty of Liberal Education)) are divided into three areas: Basic Competency / Convergence Competency / Research Competency.

- "Common Competency Courses (Basic Competency, Convergence Competency, Research Competency)" are recognized as 전선(타전공) (major elective, other major) only up to a maximum of 3, 3 and 6 credits for Master's / Doctoral / Integrated Master's-Doctoral students respectively,
and are counted toward the credits required for graduation.
- The "Research Ethics courses" are included in the Basic Competency courses.

You must complete one of the "Research Ethics courses" (applies to students admitted from the 1st semester of 2022).
However, only up to 3 credits are recognized.
(Even if you complete more than 3 credits of Research Ethics courses, only up to 3 credits are recognized.)
★ Research Ethics courses ★
1. (Faculty of Liberal Education) M2480.000100 Understanding Research Ethics (1 credit)
2. (Common course of the College of Engineering) M1570.000300 Engineering Research Ethics and Thesis Writing (2 credits)
3. (Faculty of Liberal Education / planned to change to a Basic Competency common course from 2022) 990.501A Research Ethics (3 credits)
※ If you completed a course in the "Research Ethics course group" during your Master's program at this graduate school, you do not need to take one again in the Doctoral program.
If a student admitted before the 2022 academic year completed a common competency course, the rule is applied retroactively based on the year of graduation.
* If the Research Ethics courses taken before 2022 total more than 3 credits, they are not limited to 3 credits and are all recognized.
(Recognized as another major and counted toward the credits required for graduation)
ex)
1) Research Ethics course taken in the 1st semester of 2021 + Engineering Research Ethics and Thesis Writing taken in the 2nd semester of 2021
=> Both Research Ethics and Engineering Research Ethics and Thesis Writing (5 credits) are recognized
2) Research Ethics course taken in the 1st semester of 2021 + Engineering Research Ethics and Thesis Writing taken in the 1st semester of 2022
=> Only Research Ethics (3 credits) is recognized / the course taken in the 2022 academic year is not recognized toward the credits for course completion
* Applies to students admitted from the 1st semester of 2022
: 3 credits recognized for Master's/Doctoral students, 6 credits recognized for Integrated Master's-Doctoral students
